title: eCBIS (electronic Community-Based Information System)
description: The electronic Community-Based Information System (eCBIS) project is the development of a community health application aimed at converting CBIS paper-based community health tools to a digital tool using open-source technology.

title: National TA
description: This project is geared towards providing technical support to MOH service delivery units, leadership and Governance of the Health sector including the design, revision and adoption of key policy, strategies, guidelines and SOPs.

title: Education & Training
description: This is an pre-existing project that focuses on curriculum development and training of CHAs and CHSS within the National CHA Program

title: BIRCH - Health Financing
description: The overall focus of the BIRCH project in Liberia is to contribute to the planning, financing, strengthening data management systems and improving the leadership & coordination required to accelerate scale and strengthen community health programs.

title: USAID - CHA
description: The health financing project through its 4 project pillars will provide support to the GoL to make progress in all of these areas as outlined in the Community Health Services Policy and Strategy within the broader Health Sector Financing Strategy.

title: Rivercess
description: Direct implementation of the National Community Health Program of the Ministry of Health in collaboration with the Rivercess County Health Team (RCHT). LMH has been partnering with the RCHT since 2014 to implement community health activities in areas beyond 5km from a health facility across the county.

title: Grand Bassa
description: Direct implementation of the National Community Health Program of the Ministry of Health in collaboration with the Grand Bassa County Health Team (BACHT). LMH has been partnering with the RCHT since 2017 to implement community health activities in areas beyond 5km from a health facility across the county. Grand Bassa is where LMH is conducting an impact evaluation of the National Community Health Program of the Ministry of Health.

title: Mothers to Mothers
description: In partnership with MSD for Mothers and the Ministry of Health in Liberia, Last Mile Health (LMH) proposes to implement mother-to-mother (MtM) support groups within Liberia’s National Community Health Assistant (CHA) Program in one district in rural Liberia.

title: Malaria
description: Last Mile Health (LMH) has been partnering with the government of Liberia since 2016 to design, scale, and strengthen the NCHP, and GlaxoSmithKlein provided critical financial support for LMH’s activities in partnership with the Liberia MOH from 2020-2022 through the CEO Roundtable partnership. LMH works in close collaboration with the Ministry to strengthen their capacity to manage and improve the performance of the program.
